description: This source file contains unit test classes for the AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory in the Orleans.Streaming namespace, with specific tests for SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL implementations. It defines an abstract base test class and concrete subclasses, as well as methods to verify factory creation, cache retrieval, stream queue mapper, and adapter instantiation.
